name: ariaweave
description: Chrome extension that injects real alt/aria-label attributes into the live DOM

scripts.package: rm -rf dist ariaweave.zip && mkdir -p dist && cp -R manifest.json content background popup verifier dist/ && rm -f dist/background/selfcheck.js dist/verifier/verifier.test.js dist/verifier/API.md dist/verifier/FINDINGS.md && cd dist && zip -qr ../ariaweave.zip . && cd .. && rm -rf dist && unzip -l ariaweave.zip | tail -1
